newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Monday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing
prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 3.11 billion yuan from 3.455 billion yuan last Friday with the 30-day contract the most actively traded.
Despite the fall in turnover, trading was still active with the monthly settlement for financial institutions drawing near, traders said.

Traders said they believed the rates would move in a narrow range in the short term partly due to a local newspaper report on Monday which quoted traders as saying they hoped China's bank deposit rates would remain at current levels to avoid risk on the financial markets.
"The domestic A share markets are overheated," a report by the Shenzhen-based Securities Time said. "A cut in bank deposit interest rates would add risk to the A shares markets."
